messages:
maria.k: Quick check-in — proposing a soft-sunset for the legacy envelope param (x-envelop) with a client opt-in flag for six weeks. Thoughts?
raj.patel: +1 to soft-sunset. Need a clear escape hatch for enterprise customers.
lee.dev: What about telemetry? we should track failures and fallback rates before flipping default.
maria.k: Agreed. Plan: 1) serve warning header 2) start telemetry count 3) enable opt-in via feature flag 4) after 6w flip default for non-enterprise 5) enterprise gets opt-out window. runbook attached below.
raj.patel: Can we emit a stable deprecation header like: `Deprecation: x-envelop; sunset=2025-04-15` ? clients can parse that.
lee.dev: yep. Also add a short probe that returns 204 with X-Compat-Suggest when we detect old payloads, so SDKs can auto-migrate.
maria.k: Pseudocode for the flag gating i proposed:
```
features:
  legacy_envelope_opt_in: {
    type: 'cohort',
    rollout: '10% -> 50% -> 100%',
  }
```
We should do 10% -> 50% -> 100% ramp and monitor.
release-bot: Deploy scheduled: canary tomorrow 03:00 UTC if ops approves.
raj.patel: Ops ok, pls include the compatibility probe as non-breaking and add a circuit-breaker with 5xx threshold.
lee.dev: For schema mismatches, fallback to the normalized form server-side and increment metric `compat.fallback.v1_to_v2`.
maria.k: Ops: @release-bot can you annotate the canary with `rollout: compat-probe` and keep it for 48h? :eyes:
release-bot: noted — canary tagged and will auto-roll back on SLA breach.
raj.patel: Testing: add two quick e2e cases — old envelope with attachments and malformed content. Make sure client SDK logs the header and surfaces migration hint.
lee.dev: I'll add unit tests and a quick fuzz job for envelope shapes.
maria.k: Ok, final items: docs update, SDK PRs, telemetry dashboards (fallback rate, header exposure, opt-in %) — aim to ship the canary Monday. Thanks all :thumbsup:
